featured_reviews.name: Rhea Kapoor
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited this place for a full body massage for the first time, but the experience with the receptionist was very disappointing. He had shady vibes and immediately asked for full payment (₹3000) upfront without explaining any services or understanding what I needed. I mentioned I had lower back pain, but instead of offering helpful guidance, he pushed the most expensive option, a deep tissue massage, which turned out to be way too intense for a beginner like me.

My mom, who was with me, refused to get a massage altogether because we both felt like we were being ripped off. The pricing seemed too high, and the receptionist’s attitude didn’t feel trustworthy.

The only good part was the massage therapist. She was skilled, kind, and even mentioned that deep tissue is usually not recommended for first-timers. That basic advice should have come from the front desk. Overall, poor service, overpriced treatment, and unprofessional behavior ruined what could have been a relaxing experience.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We sincerely apologize for the discomfort you experienced during your visit. This is not the level of service we aim to provide, and we take your concerns seriously.

We will be addressing the behaviour of our front desk team to ensure clear communication, proper guidance, and a more welcoming approach for all guests. Your point about recommending suitable therapies especially for first-time clients is absolutely valid, and we will ensure better consultation moving forward.

We are glad to know that you were satisfied with the therapist’s professionalism, and we appreciate you acknowledging her efforts. We truly regret that the overall experience did not meet your expectations. We have made changes to our management and staff. Please visit us again for complimentary service. Once again, we are sorry !!!

featured_reviews.name: naveen singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Rating: 0/10 (If zero was allowed)
Go here only if you want a pathetic experience on the name of massage and relaxation. And really want to waste your money and time both
After checking multiple body massage parlours in Virar and reading Google reviews, we decided to visit De Rest Spa hoping for some genuine relaxation after being extremely tired. Unfortunately, what we experienced was horrific, shocking, and deeply disappointing.

Right from the outside, the place looked very shady, but we still went ahead with hope. That turned out to be a big mistake.

The reception ambience itself was poor and unwelcoming. Once inside, the reality was far worse—only two cramped rooms, extremely unhygienic conditions, and a strong foul smell the moment we entered. The pillow was dirty, and the towel placed on it smelled awful. I requested a towel change, but even the “fresh” towel had the same foul smell. That itself says a lot about their hygiene standards.

The massage experience was equally bad. The lady assigned was completely unprofessional, had no knowledge of massage techniques or pressure points, and lacked even the minimum strength required for a massage. It felt like she had no training whatsoever.

The room continued to stink throughout. When I requested them to at least switch on the electronic diffuser with camphor, the request was casually denied saying it was “not working.” No effort, no concern, no professionalism.

What was even more surprising and unacceptable is that they took the full payment in advance and clearly stated that no service would be provided without upfront payment. For such a dirty, unhygienic, and unprofessional setup, charging ₹1500 per person is daylight robbery. Honestly, I wouldn’t even pay ₹200 for this kind of service.

This place is a big NO. Total waste of money, time, and peace of mind. As a genuine user who had such a terrible experience, I strongly urge people not to visit this spa. Please don’t fall for fake reviews—this place is highly unprofessional, poorly maintained, and absolutely not worth it.

Never ever go there. You’ll regret it.

featured_reviews.name: Subodh R
featured_reviews.review_text:
I'll be honest—I wasn’t sure what to expect. As a guy who usually unwinds with a game, a spa day felt a little outside my comfort zone. But after some not-so-subtle hints from my partner, I booked a deep tissue massage and gave it a shot.

The experience? Surprisingly awesome.

The staff was professional and welcoming. The vibe was calm with clean design, good music, and everything smelled great without being overpowering. My massage therapist knew her stuff. She worked out knots I didn’t even know I had and checked in regularly to make sure the pressure was right.

After the massage, I was left feeling relaxed, loose, and honestly kind of refreshed in a way that a gym session just doesn’t do.

Bottom line: if you're a guy on the fence about the spa thing—do it. You’ll walk out feeling like a new man.

featured_reviews.name: Rutuja Mukane
featured_reviews.review_text:
DANGEROUS, DECEPTIVE & COMPLETELY INAPPROPRIATE — AVOID THIS PLACE!

I brought my mother here hoping she’d have a peaceful massage. Instead, she was subjected to a disgusting experience. The staff repeatedly offered “extra services” with sexual undertones—completely inappropriate and unwanted. Even after she clearly said NO multiple times, they kept pushing, including suggesting a male masseuse for “better experience.” This is not a real spa. This is harassment.

They also forced us to pay the full amount upfront, refusing to even begin until the money was taken—clearly because they know no one would pay afterward once they realize how shady and uncomfortable this place is.

The massage was unprofessional, rushed, and borderline threatening. The oil used was cheap and smelly, not the olive oil they promised. The steam room was broken, and when she was asked to walk in a towel to another room (with no privacy, men nearby, and no bathrobe provided) she had to wear her oily clothes just to maintain dignity.

The second steam room was dangerously hot and foggy, and staff kept brushing off her concerns, saying it was “normal.” She walked out of there shaken, angry, and humiliated.

This place should not be allowed to operate. It is unsafe for women and highly unethical.

I panicked and asked them to condition it again, but I noticed they were using a very cheap conditioner. When I requested a better product, they initially said none was available. Only when I offered to pay for it did they give me a Matrix conditioner, and even then I was charged an extra ₹50.

A chunk of my hair came out in my hand, and I was extremely scared. I called the owner to inform them, but to my surprise he blamed it on “regular hair fall.” If that were true, I would’ve been bald by now.

The situation was not handled properly, and cheaper products were being used despite the service looking professional from the outside. The staff is good, but the quality of products and the way the issue was managed was disappointing.

Unfortunately, I will not be coming here again.
